page_title: LAZ 1-2 BOL | Lazio v Bologna 18/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Danilo Cataldi (Lazio). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
90+4' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Danilo Cataldi (Lazio), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
90+3' The yellow card is received by Michel Aebischer (Bologna).

90+3' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Fabio Maresca blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. A free kick has been awarded to Lazio.

90+2' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked. Pedro (Lazio) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
90+1' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
90+1' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) makes a slide tackle, but referee Fabio Maresca blows for a foul. Lazio win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Stefan Posch sends a terrific cross into the box. Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) gets on the end of it but his header from the centre of the box goes just wide of the left post.

86' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
85' Here is a change. Riccardo Orsolini is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna).
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) comes onto the pitch so that Victor Kristiansen can be given a rest.
84' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Taty Castellanos. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
82' Pedro (Lazio) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
81' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
79' Adam Marusic (Lazio) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.

78' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the bottom left corner. The assist goes to Victor Kristiansen and the score changes to 1:2.
77' Maurizio Sarri decides to make a substitution. Luis Alberto will be replaced by Daichi Kamada (Lazio).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Manuel Lazzari leaves the pitch and Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) comes on.
75' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) dribbles into the box, but Lukasz Skorupski is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
74' Luis Alberto (Lazio) takes the corner but it's cleared.
74' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Lazio earn a corner.
73' Today's match ends for Oussama El Azzouzi who will be replaced by Michel Aebischer (Bologna).
73' Giovanni Fabbian comes off the pitch to be replaced by Kacper Urbanski (Bologna).
73' Thiago Motta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dan Ndoye (Bologna) replacing Alexis Saelemaekers.
69' The cross into the penalty area from Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
69' A pass by Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
67' Nicolo Casale (Lazio) superbly chips the ball over a defender inside the box to feed Taty Castellanos in stride, but one of the defenders manages to clear the ball.
65' Maurizio Sarri has decided to make a change. Pedro (Lazio) replaces Gustav Isaksen.
65' The game has come to an end for Ciro Immobile. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Taty Castellanos (Lazio).
60' A pass into the penalty area from Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) is intercepted by the defence.
59' Riccardo Orsolini sends the ball into the centre of the box from the corner. Stefan Posch (Bologna) bursts through a crowd of players but heads the ball miles wide of the left post.
59' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) will take the corner.
56' Luis Alberto (Lazio) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
55' Adam Marusic (Lazio) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lukasz Skorupski intercepts the ball.
54' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the right side of the goal, but Ivan Provedel is equal to it and makes an easy save.
53' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
53' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
52' The resulting corner from Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) is cleared by the defence.
52' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Bologna force their opponents to concede a corner.
51' Bologna hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.
46' The whistle blows and Fabio Maresca starts the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Luis Alberto (Lazio) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.

44' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the right side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
44' Luis Alberto (Lazio) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
43' Luis Alberto (Lazio) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
42' Luis Alberto (Lazio) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

42' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Lukasz Skorupski is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The referee signals a corner kick to Lazio.
40' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Fabio Maresca is going to take a look using VAR.
39' Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) has a goal ruled out for offside!

39' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Fabio Maresca signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Bologna players celebrate. Goal! Ivan Provedel makes a huge mistake and Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 1:1.
39' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
37' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) takes the free kick from the edge of the box. His decent attempt goes narrowly wide of the left post.
36' Bologna have a free kick from a promising distance.
35' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) picks up a yellow card.
32' Luis Alberto (Lazio) takes the corner which is cleared.

31' Luis Alberto (Lazio) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lazio.
31' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box to the left side of the goal, but Lukasz Skorupski shows his agility and makes a save.
30' 4:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. 3:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
28' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) tries to find Gustav Isaksen, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
27' An attempted cross from Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) is cleared.
25' The referee is firm and issues Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) a deserved yellow card.

24' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) receives a lofted pass on the edge of the penalty box and without any hesitation fires the ball goalwards. It fails to worry the goalkeeper as it goes to the middle of the goal.

22' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Riccardo Orsolini, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
21' Luis Alberto (Lazio) sends a long ball in, but Lukasz Skorupski comfortably gathers the ball.

18' 1 - 0 Goal! Great link up play between Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) and Ciro Immobile gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom left corner. 1:0.
17' Stefan Posch (Bologna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
14' A goal, which was scored by Ciro Immobile (Lazio), was disallowed due to offside.
11' It looks like Patric (Lazio) may be concussed after that challenge from an opposing player. He’s definitely coming off in line and Maurizio Sarri replaces him with Nicolo Casale.
11' Patric (Lazio) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
8' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
8' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Lukasz Skorupski.
6' Sam Beukema (Bologna) picks out Giovanni Fabbian with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
2' Stefan Posch plays the ball through an opponents legs to Lewis Ferguson (Bologna), who shoots from the edge of the box. The keeper scrambles across his line but the shot rises just over the bar.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Bologna will have the kick-off.
Fabio Maresca got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
